thread:
Alex: Quick heads-up — handoff in ~15m. I'm primary tonight, Priya is secondary. Before we go live: can everyone confirm PagerDuty, AWS console, and Grafana access? Also call out any gaps and who can JIT-grant.

Priya: I have PD alerts coming through (verified). AWS console: I can view infra but I don't have the temporary role to assume ProdAdmin — only ProdRead. Grafana: I only have Viewer on the main dashboards, no edit or playlist control.

Sam: I can grant a 1h elevated role for AWS and Grafana JIT. Need a request in this thread with the target username and which permissions. I'll prefer to use our JIT flow (okta + kube token).

Nina: Reminder — runbook link here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff (please bookmark). PagerDuty escalation path is the usual: schedule 'oncall-primary' -> escalation to 'oncall-backup' after 10m -> team notify. You can verify the schedule with PD CLI: 
```
pd schedules show SCHEDULE_ID || pd schedules get SCHEDULE_ID
```
(we've pasted the ID in the runbook).

Alex: @Sam please queue JIT for @Priya for Grafana Editor + AWS ProdAssume for 1 hour. Priya — when you confirm successful assume, reply here. Also: if an incident pages, follow the quick triage in the runbook; if you can't access a dashboard, tag #eng-sre and escalate to me.

incident-bot: NOTE — recent incident #1234 resolved, no open P0s. Auto-bridge closed 02:13 UTC.

Sam: Kicking off JIT now for Priya:
```
JIT request created: https://redwood.okta.com/jit?user=priya&role=grafana.editor&ttl=1h
AWS role request: https://redwood.okta.com/jit?user=priya&role=ProdAssume&ttl=1h
```
You should get an email and an Okta push. LMK if you don't.

Priya: Got the Okta push, accepted, and I can now assume ProdAssume: 
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ProdAssume --role-session-name priya-oncall
```
I also see Grafana editor controls now, can edit playlists. Verified dashboard write.

Alex: Great — thanks. Quick reminder on escalation policy: if PD doesn't ack within 2m, escalate to backup and post in #incidents. If Grafana metrics are missing, fallback to CloudWatch and ping me directly.

Sam: One small note — logging shows a recent permission change on the grafana service account yesterday at 22:05 UTC, I posted the audit link in the runbook footnote. If you see weird dashboard errors, ping infra and include the traces.

Nina: I'll be reachable for the first hour if any routing or runbook questions pop up. If PD alerts look weird (duplicate pages), open an ops ticket and I'll take ownership.

Alex: Cool. Priya, you're secondary and reachable by PD and Slack. I'm setting my phone to DND except for PD calls — will monitor Slack every 5m. Anyone else?

Priya: All good on my end. Thanks @Sam for the quick JIT. I'm ready to take pages if needed.

Alex: Thanks team — handing off now. :white_check_mark:
